c00_golden: golden snapshot (cosmetic variants v1-v6 give the noise band)
c01_dq19: 19-bit dividend/quotient shift register; the 4 constant-zero dividend LSBs are not stored (mask from step >= 19)
c02_dq19_flip: c01 + quotient bits stored pre-complemented (q ^ negative): the output stage loses 12 XORs
c03_dq19_flip_phase: c02 + one 5-bit phase counter for state, step and done (done decoded from phase 25)
c04_dq19_flip_phase_done: c02 + one 5-bit phase counter for state and step (0 idle, 1..23 divide, 24 round); done flop kept
c05_flip: golden 23-bit register + pre-complemented quotient bits only (isolates the flip)
c06_dq19_flip_step: c02 + state merged into the 5-bit step counter (0..22 divide, 23 round, 24 idle/reset); done flop kept; step keeps golden values while busy
